title: Commented Clever Code instead of Clean Rewriting
pattern: Writing a warning comment to document tricky, fragile, or temporally coupled code instead of refactoring the code structure to be obviously safe.
why_bad: Comments are passive documentation; they do not prevent bugs. If the code is structurally fragile, it will eventually be broken by a future maintainer who neglects to read the warning comment.
source: *Code Complete*, Chapter 32, "Don't comment tricky code; rewrite it" (p. 800) / *The Pragmatic Programmer*, Topic 10.
